Document: # Rule 3.4 This server uses a New Life rule. You may not remember any events that may have happened while you were in a critical, dead, or otherwise unconscious state. You may especially not recall events that you might witness while you are a ghost. - If you enter a dead state and are brought back to life, you forget all events that led up to your death. This is also considered the basic type of memory loss for anything else that is not specified. - If you enter a dead state and are brought back via cloning or similar forms of reconstructive resuscitation, you are to forget all events that have occurred since the beginning of the shift. - This applies to any form of death that results in the complete destruction of your body. It also applies if your character is rendered unrevivable by normal means. - Respawning as a new character or taking a ghost role eliminates all memory of anything that may have happened previously in that shift. - Memory loss applies to later rounds, as full continuity is expected. If you are rendered unrecoverable at the end of a shift, you are to forget the entire shift.
